# Thales Cyber Security Solutions

> Thales CPL provides comprehensive data security and encryption solutions including the CipherTrust platform for protecting sensitive data across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

The Thales CPL website showcases enterprise-grade cybersecurity products focused on data protection, encryption, key management, and compliance. The platform addresses modern security challenges including data discovery, ransomware protection, and regulatory compliance across multiple deployment models.

## Key Topics

- CipherTrust Platform
- Data Encryption
- Key Management
- Hardware Security Modules (HSM)
- Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
- Data Masking
- Tokenization
- Database Protection
- Cloud Security
- Compliance (GDPR, PCI DSS, FIPS 140-2)
- Data Discovery & Classification
- Ransomware Protection
- Secrets Management
- Centralized Key Management
- Enterprise Security

## Core Platform & Products

- [Cyber Security Solutions | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com): Thales cyber security homepage covering data protection, encryption, and digital transformation.
- [Cyber Security Products](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/products): Product catalog of Thales security solutions including Sentinel and encryption offerings.
- [CipherTrust Data Security Platform | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/data-security-platform): CipherTrust integrated platform unifying data discovery, protection, and control.
- [Data Security | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/data-security): Thales data security overview featuring CipherTrust platform and DSPM solutions.

## Data Discovery & Classification

- [Sensitive Data Discovery and Classification | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/data-discovery-and-classification): CipherTrust data discovery and classification tool for sensitive data visualization.
- [Data Security Posture Management Solutions | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/data-security-posture-management): CipherTrust DSPM solution for cloud, SaaS, and on-prem data security compliance.

## Encryption & Data Protection

- [Data Encryption Solutions | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption): Thales encryption solutions spanning data centers, cloud, and big data environments.
- [CipherTrust Transparent Encryption (Formerly Vormetric Encryption)](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/transparent-encryption): CipherTrust transparent encryption with centralized key management and audit logging.
- [CipherTrust Database Protection | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/database-protection): CipherTrust database encryption with column-level protection and key management.
- [Application Data Protection With Centralized key Management | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/application-data-protection): CADP SDK for application-level encryption and key management integration.
- [CipherTrust Transparent Encryption: Ransomware Data Protection](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/ciphertrust-ransomware-protection): CTE ransomware protection monitoring for abnormal I/O activity detection.

## Data Masking & Tokenization

- [CipherTrust Data Masking Solutions | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/data-masking-solutions): CipherTrust dynamic and static data masking for sensitive data protection.
- [CipherTrust Tokenization Solution | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/tokenization): CipherTrust tokenization for sensitive data protection with PCI DSS compliance.
- [CipherTrust Batch Data Transformation](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/batch-data-transformation): High-performance static data masking leveraging tokenization and encryption.
- [CipherTrust Data Protection Gateway | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/ciphertrust-data-protection-gateway): CipherTrust gateway for encryption, tokenization, and masking with microservices.

## Key Management & Hardware Security

- [Key Management Solutions | Encryption Key Management Software | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/key-management): Thales key management solutions for on-premises and cloud encryption compliance.
- [Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) | Thales](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/hardware-security-modules): Thales Luna HSMs for cryptographic key lifecycle protection and compliance.
- [Luna General Purpose HSMs](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/hardware-security-modules/general-purpose-hsms): Luna HSM product family with network, PCIe, and USB deployment options.

## Advanced Solutions

- [CipherTrust Enterprise Secrets Management Solution - Powered by Akeyless](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/ciphertrust-secrets-management): CipherTrust secrets management powered by Akeyless for DevOps automation.
- [CipherTrust RESTful Data Protection](https://cpl.thalesgroup.com/encryption/ciphertrust-restful-data-protection): CRDP REST API for simplified data protection without security management overhead.
